versions.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-error-logger.
- Automates recording of agent errors, including details, causes, fixes, and tags.
- Supports manual error search, pattern recognition, and monthly/error-type analytics.
- Provides proactive error reminders before new tasks based on error logs.
- Includes scripts for error recording, querying, and report generation.
- Offers best practices, extensibility suggestions, and related research references.
